personality.title: Night Travel Persona Test
personality.subtitle: Discover your Daejeon night-travel style in 12 questions — with night courses picked for your type.
personality.introBody: Just pick your gut choice for each 'what if' scene. There are no wrong answers — go with what pulls you.
personality.noCourses: No courses to recommend yet — try building one on the courses page.

q1.text: You've made it to Daejeon Station! Checked in, and about 3 hours left before nightfall. First move?
q1.a: Just start walking. Wander the nearby alleys and stumble onto a local bar or a tiny cafe.
q1.b: Check what festivals, night markets or events are on tonight, and head where the crowd is.
q1.c: Take it easy. Find a scenic riverside walk near the hotel and stroll quietly.
q1.d: Hold on — search 'Daejeon must-see night spots' first and plan a route around photogenic places.

q2.text: You reach the night market — but you're short on time. If you can pick only one zone?
q2.a: Head for the tucked-away alley or the row of local food stalls only locals seem to know.
q2.b: Go where the game booths, hands-on stalls and buskers are clustered.
q2.c: Hit the food zone and taste a few of the region's signature dishes.
q2.d: Head near the photo spot where the whole market fits in one frame.

q3.text: As you walk, a local suddenly speaks up: "This pub is really hot — want to come along?"
q3.a: The thrill of joining strangers wins — you say "Let's go!" right away.
q3.b: Your plan is set, so you politely decline and stick to it.
q3.c: You hesitate a bit, but the hope of a new connection wins and you tag along.
q3.d: You check the pub's vibe on social media first, then weigh if it's your taste.

q4.text: You must pick just one Daejeon night tour course. Which pulls you most?
q4.a: Explore on foot — hidden alleys, local bars and secret night-view points you'd never find by day.
q4.b: Hear Daejeon's history and city stories while touring late-night venues and storytelling walks.
q4.c: A 'night food crawl' through night markets, local eateries and late-night bites.
q4.d: Spend the night among people, with outdoor performances and festivals.

q5.text: It starts to drizzle. You have an umbrella and one or two more hours to roam. You…
q5.a: Even better — head to a lesser-known area where you can explore rainy alleys and local bars.
q5.b: Find somewhere indoors like a theater, museum or exhibition to enjoy culture and stories out of the rain.
q5.c: Rain means food. Move to an indoor food court or covered market zone and keep eating.
q5.d: Change plans — settle into a cafe near the hotel and relax over the night view.

q6.text: How do you take photos while traveling?
q6.a: Photos are just for memories — I record only enough to remember later.
q6.b: That lighting is gorgeous! I hunt for beautiful views and enjoy the shots themselves.
q6.c: Anything tasty or unusual, I make sure to snap once.
q6.d: Snapped it! Posted it! I love putting it on my story live and watching the reactions.

q7.text: You've got some time to yourself. The most ideal scene is…
q7.a: Open the map app and follow a path few people take to discover somewhere interesting.
q7.b: Read about the city's history and culture in a quiet spot and get lost in thought.
q7.c: Listen to music by the river or an overlook and gaze at the city lights for a long while.
q7.d: Watch the food and the flow of people at a night market or on the street.

q8.text: A friend asks, "If you had to post one highlight of your Daejeon trip, what would it be?" You pick…
q8.a: A photo of a hidden alley or local shop — the 'wait, this place existed?' kind.
q8.b: A night-view shot with beautiful light and lines, or a moody walking snap.
q8.c: A photo of a unique late-night dish you feel you can only get in Daejeon.
q8.d: A scene of people laughing together, or a clip from a performance or festival.

q9.text: There are four night programs you could join. If you sign up for just one first?
q9.a: A small local bar tour (roaming the alleys with a local).
q9.b: A night history and culture guided tour.
q9.d: A night festival or live performance.

q10.text: Your schedule wrapped up early — suddenly a whole 2 hours opened up. How do you use it?
q10.a: Head to a neighborhood not on the plan — hop on a bus or subway on a whim.
q10.b: Wind down and relax at a cafe or hot spring, wrapping up the day.
q10.c: There's still something I haven't eaten — go back to the market or a local spot for more.
q10.d: Scan social media and the map app to hunt for 'a night spot only I know' in Daejeon.

q11.text: The trip is ending. Recalling Daejeon's night, the first ideal scene that comes to mind is…
q11.a: Walking a newly found alley and meeting a view you didn't expect.
q11.b: Listening to or reflecting on the city's stories, history and culture in a quiet place.
q11.c: Laughing under the lights, enjoying music, performances and festivals with others.
q11.d: Walking with food in hand amid the smells and sounds of the night market.

q12.text: Last night of the trip. Which thought would make you go, 'Daejeon… I have to come back'?
q12.a: The feeling that there are still so many alleys and local spots left to explore.
q12.b: Curiosity to learn Daejeon's culture, history and art more deeply.
q12.c: The urge to try more dishes and new late-night combos you didn't get to.
q12.d: The wish to feel again the gatherings and vibe with the people you met in Daejeon.

explorer.name: NIGHT EXPLORER
explorer.desc: You get the biggest kick out of exploring new alleys, local spots and off-the-map routes. 'We came all this way — let's check out where others don't go' comes naturally to you.
strengths: A knack for finding paths others skip
Ease with going with the flow
Ability to uncover local-only places
traits: You prefer wandering over a fixed route.
Alleys, local spots and off-map routes thrill you.
You're drawn to 'where others don't go'.
tips: Plan a walking route through the alleys.
Aim for local bars and food-stall rows.
Leave a lesser-known area for last.

player.name: NIGHT PLAYER
player.desc: You build your night around things to do — festivals, night markets, games, hands-on experiences and events. You love high-energy places alive with sound and light.
strengths: Energy that lifts the mood
High spirits even in crowds
A quick eye for things to do
traits: Festivals and events are your night's core.
You love places alive with sound and light.
You can't walk past a hands-on booth.
tips: Check tonight's festivals and events first.
Head where buskers and shows gather.
Pick a market packed with activity booths.

socializer.name: NIGHT SOCIALIZER
socializer.desc: You'd rather spend the night among people — locals, fellow travelers, companions. You enjoy meeting new people and good conversation, and remember trips as relationships.
strengths: Easy rapport with strangers
Warmth that remembers trips as bonds
The spark that lifts any group
traits: Together beats solo for you.
You enjoy new people, talk and meetups.
You remember trips by 'who with'.
tips: Look for small local tours and meetups.
Use guesthouse lounges and pubs.
Festival-style courses suit you well.

viewLover.name: NIGHT VIEW LOVER
viewLover.desc: You savor light and landscape itself — night views, mood, quiet walks, photo spots. You linger by rivers, overlooks and trails, soaking in the city's night air.
strengths: Patience to savor a mood
An eye for light and landscape
A taste for quiet moments
traits: You savor night views and mood itself.
You linger by rivers, overlooks and trails.
You love feeling the city's night air.
tips: Add an overlook or riverside walk.
Aim for the blue hour after sunset.
Keep a relaxed pace and stay a while.

culturist.name: NIGHT CULTURIST
culturist.desc: You want to know the city's story through history, art and storytelling walks. Late-night museums, exhibitions, performances and story tours pull you in.
strengths: Curiosity that reads a city's context
The gift of deepening a trip with stories
A love of learning
traits: You're curious about the city's story and art.
Late-night museums and exhibits draw you.
The more you know, the more you see.
tips: Check late-opening exhibits and museums.
Book a guided or storytelling tour.
Build your route around history stops.

foodie.name: NIGHT FOODIE
foodie.desc: For you, what you eat is the heart of the night — night markets, local eateries, late-night food runs. Daejeon after dark is your time to complete a personal food crawl.
strengths: Courage to try new flavors
A talent for finding local gems
Charm that bonds people over food
traits: Night markets and local eats are the point.
Discovering new dishes delights you.
You want to know a place through its food.
tips: Add a night-market food tour.
Chain local eateries into a food crawl.
List the region's signature dishes.

trendsetter.name: NIGHT TRENDSETTER
trendsetter.desc: How you'll show your night on social media — photos, video, stories, live — is part of the trip itself. You naturally think about how to capture and share the moment.
strengths: A knack for capturing the moment
A quick eye for trends
Joy in sharing experiences
traits: You think about how to capture the night.
Photos, video, stories and live come naturally.
You're tuned to hot spots and photo spots.
tips: Build a route around photo spots.
Aim for blue hour and great lighting.
List hot spots and photo landmarks ahead.
